b-lab3-6: ls Dir/Dir2 | grep -E 'A.*A.*A' | grep AA > Dir/Texts/names.txt
b-exercises1-1c: ls | grep t | grep f >> files.txt
b-exercises1-4b: ls ../Dir6c | grep -E '^.{5,}$' | grep -E '[0-9].{0,2}$' | while read f; do rm "../Dir6c/$f"; done
b-exercises2-1: for ((i=1;i<=99;i++)); do printf -v n '%03d' "$i"; touch "$1/${2}_$n"; done
b-exercises2-2: read d; if [ -d "$d" ]; then for a in {0..4}; do for b in {0..4}; do for c in {0..4}; do touch "$d/$a$b$c"; done; done; done; fi
b-exercises2-3: for d in "$@"; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then ls "$d"; else echo "There is no directory with the path $d"; fi; done
b-exercises2-4: read -r line; sum=0; n=0; for w in $line; do sum=$((sum+${#w})); n=$((n+1)); done; echo $((sum/n))
b-exercises2-5: read -r line; : > "$1"; for w in $line; do echo "$w ${#w}" >> "$1"; done
b-exercises2-6: for f in "$1"/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; n=${f##*/}; upper=$(echo "$n" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'); [ "$n" = "$upper" ] || mv "$f" "$1/$upper"; done
b-exercises2-7: for f in "$1"/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" "$2/${f##*/}Copy"; done
b-exercises2-10: sum=0; max=0; for n in "$@"; do sum=$((sum+n)); [ "$n" -le "$max" ] || max=$n; done; echo "$max $((sum/$#))"
b-exercises2-12: v=1; for ((i=1;i<=$1;i++)); do line=''; for ((j=1;j<=i;j++)); do line="$line$v "; v=$((v+1)); done; echo "${line% }."; done
b-exercises2-13: a=(); while read n && [ "$n" -ne 0 ]; do a+=("$n"); done; read idx; count=0; for n in "${a[@]}"; do [ "$n" -le "${a[idx]}" ] || count=$((count+1)); done; echo "${a[idx]} $count"
b-exercises2-14: a=(); stop=0; while read -r line; do for n in $line; do if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then stop=1; break; fi; a+=("$n"); done; [ "$stop" -eq 0 ] || break; done; for ((i=${#a[@]}-1;i>=0;i--)); do printf '%s ' "${a[i]}"; done; echo
b-exercises2-15: sum=0; count=0; while read name n tag; do [ "$name" != Done ] || break; if [ "$tag" = "$1" ]; then echo "$name $n"; sum=$((sum+n)); count=$((count+1)); fi; done; echo $((sum/count))
b-exercises2-17: while read f; do [ -f "$f" ] && break; done; count=0; while read n; do if [ -f "$1/$n" ]; then cp "$1/$n" "../${n}Copy"; count=$((count+1)); fi; done < "$f"; echo "$count"
b-exercises2-18: while read n; do [ -f "$1/$n" ] && break; done; count=0; : > "$1/${n}Words"; for w in $(cat "$1/$n"); do echo "$w" >> "$1/${n}Words"; count=$((count+1)); done; echo "$count"
b-exercises2-19: a=(); while read n && [ "$n" -ne 0 ]; do a+=("$n"); done; read lo; read hi; sum=0; count=0; for ((i=0;i<${#a[@]};i++)); do n=${a[i]}; if [ "$n" -gt "$lo" ] && [ "$n" -lt "$hi" ]; then echo "Index: $i Value: $n"; sum=$((sum+n)); count=$((count+1)); fi; done; echo "Average is $((sum/count))"
